solasRas2025.authority: SOLAS Skills and Labour Market Research Unit
solasRas2025.title: Recruitment Agency Survey on difficult-to-fill vacancies — November 2025
solasRas2025.note: Official selected-recruitment-agency survey. Used only as a conservative vacancy fallback because it does not publish an occupation-level vacancy numerator/denominator.

projection.proxyReason: Cedefop publishes the forecast at the broader ICT professionals group; the bulletin also warns the 2021 ICT baseline is understated.

shortage_signal.explanation: SOLAS 2025 lists software developers/engineers as a national shortage.

vacancy_intensity.proxyReason: 2025 survey explicitly names software developers; 2024 evidence also named software developers/engineers, so persistence is supported. No occupation-level denominator is published.
vacancy_intensity.reason: Conservative fallback: low vacancy intensity (3) + one persistence point (1). The survey confirms repeated difficult-to-fill mentions but cannot support a vacancy-rate band above low without a denominator.

industry_diversity.reason: SOLAS publishes sector shares for the wider ICT occupation family, not a complete comparable sector distribution for software developers alone.

relative_salary.reason: CSO SES05/SES06 detailed occupation earnings must be extracted and mapped before Pay can be scored.

entry_accessibility.proxyReason: Legacy Ireland evidence describes degree and work-based ICT routes but needs Career Data Foundation source records before publication.

entry_burden.proxyReason: Legacy Ireland evidence records no universal statutory professional registration; source record still needs normalization.

mapping.title: Information technology and telecommunications professionals n.e.c. — cyber-security analyst scope

labourMarket.proxyReason: SOLAS publishes ICT professionals n.e.c. as the broader employment group.

projection.proxyReason: Cedefop forecast is for ICT professionals, broader than cyber-security analysis.

shortage_signal.proxyReason: SOLAS shortage wording is IT analysts/engineers and difficult-to-fill evidence includes cyber/security specialisms.

vacancy_intensity.proxyReason: 2025 survey names security engineering within ICT; 2024 evidence also included security roles. This is a broader specialist proxy for Cybersecurity Analyst.
vacancy_intensity.reason: Conservative fallback: low vacancy intensity (3) + one persistence point (1). The survey confirms repeated difficult-to-fill mentions but cannot support a vacancy-rate band above low without a denominator.

industry_diversity.reason: No complete cyber-security occupation-by-industry share distribution has been normalized.

relative_salary.reason: Detailed official earnings proxy has not yet been extracted from CSO SES.

entry_accessibility.proxyReason: Existing official apprenticeship/education evidence needs normalization into Career Data Foundation.

entry_burden.proxyReason: No universal statutory registration is currently recorded; source-level normalization remains.

mapping.title: IT business analysts, architects and systems designers — data engineering / architecture scope

labourMarket.proxyReason: The published SOLAS group is broader than Data Engineer.

projection.proxyReason: Cedefop forecast is for ICT professionals.

shortage_signal.proxyReason: SOLAS identifies IT analysts/engineers as shortage roles; Data Engineer is a constrained scope within the mapped official group.

employment_momentum.proxyReason: Uses the broader ICT professionals n.e.c. growth series.

vacancy_intensity.proxyReason: 2025 survey explicitly names data engineers and related data roles; 2024 evidence also included data specialists. No occupation-level denominator is published.
vacancy_intensity.reason: Conservative fallback: low vacancy intensity (3) + one persistence point (1). The survey confirms repeated difficult-to-fill mentions but cannot support a vacancy-rate band above low without a denominator.

industry_diversity.reason: No complete Data Engineer occupation-by-industry distribution has been normalized.

relative_salary.reason: Detailed official earnings proxy has not yet been extracted from CSO SES.

entry_accessibility.proxyReason: Legacy official pathway evidence requires Career Data Foundation normalization.

entry_burden.proxyReason: No universal statutory registration is currently recorded; source-level normalization remains.

labourMarket.proxyReason: SOLAS combines civil engineers and construction project managers in the published 2025 chart.

projection.proxyReason: Cedefop forecast is broader than Civil Engineer.

shortage_signal.proxyReason: SOLAS lists the combined national group 'Civil engineers & construction project managers' as a shortage.

employment_momentum.proxyReason: Uses the combined civil engineer/construction project manager growth series.

projected_growth.proxyReason: Uses broader Science & engineering professionals forecast.

vacancy_intensity.proxyReason: 2025 survey explicitly names site/civil engineers; 2024 evidence also named civil/site engineers. The fallback remains broader than a clean vacancy-rate statistic.
vacancy_intensity.reason: Conservative fallback: low vacancy intensity (3) + one persistence point (1). The survey confirms repeated difficult-to-fill mentions but cannot support a vacancy-rate band above low without a denominator.

industry_diversity.reason: Published construction-family sector shares are broader than Civil Engineer.

relative_salary.reason: Detailed official earnings row/proxy has not yet been extracted from CSO SES.

entry_accessibility.proxyReason: Existing Engineers Ireland accredited-program route needs Career Data Foundation normalization.

entry_burden.proxyReason: Professional titles are valuable but generic Civil Engineer practice is not recorded as universally subject to one personal statutory register.

mapping.title: Construction project managers and related professionals

labourMarket.proxyReason: SOLAS combines civil engineers and construction project managers in the published 2025 chart.

projection.proxyReason: The Cedefop manager group explicitly includes managers in construction, but is much broader than Construction Project Manager.

shortage_signal.proxyReason: SOLAS lists the combined national group 'Civil engineers & construction project managers' as a shortage.

employment_momentum.proxyReason: Uses the combined civil engineer/construction project manager growth series.

projected_growth.proxyReason: Production & specialised services managers explicitly includes managers in construction.

vacancy_intensity.proxyReason: 2025 survey explicitly names project/site managers; 2024 evidence also named project/site managers. No occupation-level denominator is published.
vacancy_intensity.reason: Conservative fallback: low vacancy intensity (3) + one persistence point (1). The survey confirms repeated difficult-to-fill mentions but cannot support a vacancy-rate band above low without a denominator.

industry_diversity.reason: No complete Construction Project Manager occupation-by-industry distribution has been normalized.

relative_salary.reason: Detailed official earnings row/proxy has not yet been extracted from CSO SES.

entry_accessibility.proxyReason: Legacy Ireland evidence uses degree/technical education plus experience; source-level normalization remains.

entry_burden.proxyReason: No universal statutory construction-manager register is recorded; role/site requirements still need normalized blocker evidence.

mapping.title: Chartered and certified accountants — accountant scope

labourMarket.proxyReason: SOLAS reports the broader accountants & tax experts group.

projection.proxyReason: Cedefop forecast is broader than Accountants.

shortage_signal.reason: SOLAS reports strong demand and difficult-to-fill accountant roles but does not publish a blanket accountant shortage finding; absence is not converted into confirmed-not-shortage.

employment_momentum.proxyReason: Uses accountants & tax experts group growth.

projected_growth.proxyReason: Uses broader Business & administration professionals forecast.

vacancy_intensity.proxyReason: 2025 survey explicitly names several accountant specialisms; 2024 evidence also named accountants. This supports persistence but not a numeric vacancy rate.
vacancy_intensity.reason: Conservative fallback: low vacancy intensity (3) + one persistence point (1). The survey confirms repeated difficult-to-fill mentions but cannot support a vacancy-rate band above low without a denominator.

industry_diversity.reason: SOLAS describes cross-sector demand but the exact complete sector-share vector required for HHI is not normalized.

relative_salary.reason: Detailed official earnings row/proxy has not yet been extracted from CSO SES.

entry_accessibility.proxyReason: Professional qualification, degree and apprenticeship routes exist; exact rubric inputs still need normalization.

entry_burden.proxyReason: Generic accountancy is not treated as one universally licensed occupation; employment-permit recognition rules remain separate context.

labourMarket.proxyReason: SOLAS publishes Architects & town planners as the broader group.

projection.proxyReason: Cedefop forecast is much broader than Architect.

shortage_signal.reason: SOLAS identifies Quantity Surveyors—not generic Architects—as the explicit shortage within the relevant construction discussion; this evidence must not be borrowed.

employment_momentum.proxyReason: Uses Architects & town planners group growth.

projected_growth.proxyReason: Uses broader Science & engineering professionals forecast.

vacancy_intensity.reason: Grouped recruitment evidence exists, but a defensible Architect-only numeric intensity input is not yet normalized.

industry_diversity.reason: No complete Architect occupation-by-industry share vector has been normalized.

relative_salary.reason: Detailed official earnings row/proxy has not yet been extracted from CSO SES.

entry_accessibility.proxyReason: RIAI route is sourced, but the current point conversion still needs Career Data Foundation raw/normalized records.

entry_burden.proxyReason: Architect is a protected title with a statutory registration pathway; exact rubric inputs remain to be normalized.

mapping.title: Radiographers — diagnostic and therapeutic radiography scope

labourMarket.proxyReason: SOLAS publishes a broader 'other healthcare professionals' group that includes radiographers.

projection.proxyReason: Cedefop forecast is broader than Radiographer and SOLAS cautions that healthcare demand may be stronger than the baseline forecast.

shortage_signal.reason: SOLAS marks shortage evidence for the wider other-healthcare-professionals group as inconclusive; this cannot be converted to a confirmed radiographer shortage or confirmed-not-shortage.

projected_growth.proxyReason: Uses broader Health professionals forecast and retains the SOLAS caveat.

vacancy_intensity.reason: SOLAS difficult-to-fill survey names radiographers, but no clean numeric vacancy denominator/intensity has been normalized.

industry_diversity.reason: Healthcare concentration must be measured as real concentration, not replaced with a missing-data zero; exact shares are not yet normalized.

relative_salary.reason: HSE pay scales are useful context but are not silently treated as a national occupation median; CSO SES mapping remains under review.

entry_accessibility.proxyReason: CORU-approved qualification route is sourced; exact rubric inputs still need normalization.

entry_burden.proxyReason: CORU protected-title registration is a real burden; exact rubric inputs remain to be normalized.
